spanGrp.span: And what else? The weddings! I will mention something to you, What did they tell you about them? How did they arrange weddings?
They told me...
Did they tell you about the presents that they used to get?
No, no one told me about the presents, no
The mother of the bride, the mother of the bride or the mother of the groom? No, ## the mother of the bride, I remember the presents of the big sister's wedding
This is a convential thing for me, they bring the woven fabric, do you know about the woven fabric piece?
Is it because she sews with it?
No, no, no, no, one second, one roll of woven fabric, for example, ē, like this for example, this is a big piece of woven fabric, we called it 'one piece', pieces, the mother of the bride brings...
What is its scope?
You distribute it as a presents to the...
yes, but she is the bride...
no, no, no, this is separate, this is special, the people deliver it, they bring three bundles, we call it 'ṭāga' (a bundle)
They called it a ṭāga, normal, the roll, the woven fabric, they call it a ṭāga, ṭiyāg in the plural, one is called a ṭāga
And what do you do with it?
You would take measurments, and you would distribute it as pieces
Take this, measure out of it a dress for yourself , take this measure for yourself..., for her family, her maternal aunts, her paternal aunts
all of them who were invited
No not all of them, she who comes to her to visit, we call it 'tsayyir', 'tsayyir' meaning she comes to visit
she visits her, meaning like I tell you, 'Gunda, I will 'sayyir' to you', meaning I will visit you

She who comes to visit her, she gives her blessing, meaning she says congratulations and such, she gives her blessing, she gives her blessing to her, she says congratulations on your daughter's wedding and so, and she gives her, it used to be three metres...
The mother of the bride?
The mother of the bride, she comes and takes, she takes this piece
She takes a metre, two metres, three and she cuts them, this is for one person, one metre, two, three, this is for...
and each one is able to measure herself
yes, very good, you reminded me that they used to sew their own clothes ((notice the stress change from malābis to malabis-hum))

She who had a sewing machine, she would sew for herself, she sews for her daughter and she sews for, my sister used to sew before (how to translate f-il-bidāya in this case), and she still sews, my sister is still a tailor.
But we did not know, we didn't take things to the ateliers and things like that did not exist. And so they used to sew...
Do you know how to sew or you don't?
No
Neither do I
my sister...
I'm not good in these sort of things
My big sister, the one whom you have met at Umm Salman's with Umm Abd al-rahim, that one, she sews even up to this day, she sews everything
she sews everything, she sews, things for venues, she sews dresses, whatever you want
and there was ē.... What's up with the macaroni? (talking to another person regarding the pasta)
Check on it, check on it, if it's redish on top, that's it, shut it off.
Let me drink my coffee, how's the coffee?
It's excellent, thank you

May God grant you good health, there was, she would give them one, she would come to her, she visits her, she would give her her blessing, she would give her a piece of cloth, and she would give the maternal aunts of the bride
the paternal aunts of the bride, pieces of cloth, this was a pleasant thing, the gifts of the wedding, this was a pleasant thing to do
Very well, but was this done before the wedding?
yes,yes, now it has changed, of course
there aren't any gifts, (stuttering)... The mother of the bride doesn't bring the gifts
Now the people are the ones who bring gifts to the bride
Naturally, the presents have changed
And what are the normal presents, meaning what are they? Are they something traditions or must one bring...
No, no...
Many would come...
No, no...
For example, most would bring...
No, no the gifts...
What happened?
The gifts, no, they have changed
fine perfumes, international brands
gifts, everything
perfumes
Do they bring the things to the house, for example?
A bouquet of flowers
yes
We do the same
yes, things for the household
Sometimes they say no, we will give money
Money, sometimes they put it in a bouquet, a bouquet of flowers, they put the money. Have you not seen this or social media?
No, I haven't seen this
I feel like you're not quite aware on what happens on social media
No
I will tell you, the distribution naturally have changes, the deliveries, the reception let me write for you, the wedding reception, the wedding reception
Have you seen?... Shall we bring the pizza, ʔAmal? Shall I bring you tea or juice? Whatever you want
Water, I drink only water
What do you want to drink (eat) with the pizza, tea or juice?
Water
Water? fine. ʔAmal, take a look at the pizza, if it has gotten too cold heat it up.
Amal, and cover it... ?Amal!
cut it in organized pieces /talking to ʔAmal/ she doesn't know anything
